messages:
alana: Pushed PR #5483 with docs for KV-prefetch + dashboard cost/latency breakdown examples. Needs quick review for Ruby & Go SDK snippets and broken link sweep. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5483
sam: looking
sam: skimmed ruby snippet — small escape issue with backticks in the inline example. I'll open a tiny patch.
mike: can you paste the snippet here? i can test against go sdk samples later.
sam: sure — ruby snippet is:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.prefetch.kv(prefix: "session:", limit: 50)
puts resp.entries.map(&:key)
```
sam: the problem is the `resp.entries.map(&:key)` line in the inline code block gets HTML-escaped in the generated site, so needs explicit fenced block with language and no inline backticks in prose.
lena: for go i tried this locally and found the example omitted ctx usage. suggest:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
entries, err := c.PrefetchKV(ctx, "session:", 50)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(len(entries))
```
lena: + add ctx to keep examples consistent w/ other SDKs.
tariq: also, one of the links in the "cost breakdown" section points to /docs/console/old-metrics — 404. i think it should be /docs/console/metrics-v2
alana: good catch. i'll update. also there's a small note about "latency shading" that needs clearer wording for SLO owners.
sam: i'll push a tiny commit to fix ruby escaping and add a sentence about SLO owners reading the prescriptive rollout steps.
docs-bot: build/checks — docs build passed for branch docs/pr-5483 — 2 warnings (markdown link reference). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/1234
alana: thanks @sam and @lena. can someone approve the PR after sam's commit? want to merge before EOD so we can ship the patch with the release.
mike: i'll approve after i run the go snippet once more — will ping when done.
sam: pushed fix: removed inline backticks in prose, added fenced codeblocks, updated link to metrics-v2.
mike: tested go snippet, works. :thumbsup:
alana: merging now. thx everyone, will follow up if QA flags anything.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for docs-site (staging) — job 98765
alana: filed follow-up ticket to revisit the "latency shading" explainer with performance team: #789
sam: noted — will add a short example about batching impact in that ticket.
